title: Fix MediaSearchService Pre-existing Timeout Test Failures

sprint.goal: Eliminate the 7 pre-existing timeout failures in MediaSearchService sibling tests (enrichment, cornerCases, customFormat) that are caused by vi.useFakeTimers() blocking the setTimeout-wrapped searchWithTimeout implementation.
stories: S1: Diagnose fake-timer interaction and write a Red reproduction test
S2: Refactor searchWithTimeout to accept an injectable clock/timeout or replace fake timers with system-time fakes
S3: Update enrichment, cornerCases, and customFormat test files to use the new pattern
S4: Verify all MediaSearchService tests pass in isolation and together
sprint.demo_notes: Run the three failing test files together and observe 0 failures; root CI green gate passes without pre-existing MediaSearchService timeouts.
